subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Zhu Erdan, a young man in a white brocade robe, seated upright in the hall, whose face and wardrobe come from his identity reference.
<Subject 2> is his wife, a woman in coarse grey-blue cloth, head lowered, holding a teacup, whose face and wardrobe come from her identity reference.
<Subject 3> is the sunlit main hall of the Zhuangyuan mansion, with a plaque reading "状元府", lattice doors and cold daylight, coming from the scene reference.

summary:
[reference generation] A 9.3-second sunlit hall scene. The camera descends from the hall plaque to the wife bringing tea, then to the teacup, finally on Zhu Erdan's cold side glance as he thinks, without speaking aloud, that his wife is ugly and unfit to be seen.

detailed_description:
The video is a realistic Chinese period-drama interior, cold daylight through lattice doors.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot. The camera starts from the plaque reading "状元府" centered in the hall and tilts down to the seat. <Subject 1> sits upright in the center. <Subject 2> approaches from the left, head lowered, holding a teacup with both hands to chest level, and stops half a pace before the seat.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up from a slight high angle on the teacup. Focus moves from the rim of the cup down to her lowered face; the cup stops half an inch from the table. Her hands are normal, five fingers complete.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, hard cut to a close-up of <Subject 1>. He turns his eyes coldly toward the wife at his left, brows knit, face turned aside, lips completely closed, cold daylight crossing his jaw and the collar of his white brocade robe. His inner voice (S1) says as an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese]面目可憎，出不得台面。</d> while his lips remain completely closed and he does not speak aloud.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet hall room tone, faint rustle of coarse cloth as she steps closer, the soft clink of the teacup being set down, then silence.
